title: Zingy Zucchini Yogurt Pancake
description: A fermented and silky savory dish featuring a ready rolled shortcrust pastry base, wood-fired-baked in a Dutch oven. This meal-prep Russian dish is fodmap-friendly.

ingredients.name: Yogurt Baking Powder Mix
ingredients.notes: 1 part yogurt to 3 parts baking powder, whisked together

instructions: Preheat Dutch oven over medium heat.
Mix yogurt and almond milk with a pinch of salt and vanilla extract. Whisk in yogurt baking powder mix until smooth.
Pour mixture into shortcrust pastry base evenly.
Place on wood-fired-bake grate, add charcoal to Dutch oven for direct heat.
Bake at 200°C (392°F) for 25 minutes or until edges are golden brown and center is set.
Remove from oven and let cool before serving.
